# Celebrate — celebrate.oze.au

> Personalised celebration pages for birthdays and life’s milestones, by Colin Dixon / OzOnLine (Mallacoota, Australia).

## Pages
- [Home](https://celebrate.oze.au/): What Celebrate provides — invitations, messages, photos, video, music, 360° venue experiences and lasting digital memories.
- [Shirley Dixon’s 90th](https://celebrate.oze.au/shirley90/): Completed celebration showcase (25 July 2026, Karbeethong Lodge, Mallacoota; about 70 guests).
- [Original invitation archive](https://celebrate.oze.au/shirley90/invitation.html): Historical pre-event invitation for Shirley’s 90th.

## Key facts — Shirley’s 90th
- Who: Shirley Dixon
- Occasion: 90th birthday
- When: Saturday 25 July 2026
- Where: Karbeethong Lodge, 16 Schnapper Point Drive, Mallacoota VIC 3892, Australia
- Attendance: about 70 family members and friends
- Lodge bookings: Graeme and Jenny — (03) 5158 0411 — admin@karbeethonglodge.com.au — https://www.karbeethonglodge.com.au/
- Celebrate is not the booking agent for Karbeethong Lodge
